Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649941. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649941', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
